frontendChanges: Prior candidate contains GB dictionaries/suffix rules, bounded read/lead context and clock handling, and preserved 2026-10-30 notices. This portable bundle additionally rewrites only the recorded package-location import specifiers and adds per-file modification headers; exact original and output identities and byte patches are listed below.

graphDerivations.historicalPathMapping: In the preserved original record, remove gpl-free/ from graph and licenseTextPath paths; notices/ paths are relative to this vendor directory.

excluded: The eight Kokoro model/tokenizer/config/voice assets are not bundled; Host preparation owns their explicit fixed download.
No nested node_modules. Fixed package metadata retained for provenance, not a complete independently installable npm distribution.
No native addons, kokoro-js, phonemizer, eSpeak, Python runtime, or external TTS.
No experiment reports, export environments, personal paths, or AGENTS.md.
No additional vendor pruning: all files in the fixed four dependency trees and observed ORT subtree retained, including suffix-thumb/src/test/index.js.

missing: Complete ORT source commit and artifact relationship
Exact Eigen and other C++ component revisions/files/patches
Artifact-specific corresponding-source acquisition and applicable notice map
runtimeBinarySourceMapping.result: Pending, not evidence of either mandatory GPL or final GPL-free/licence admission; repository superset notices and source-offer text are retained.
